newsitem.title: THAILAND: STA fails to honour interest payment.
newsitem.headline: STA fails to honour interest payment.

text.p: Rubber wood producer STA Group (1993) Plc said on Friday its cashflow and financial problems prevented the company from honouring its obligation on a second interest payment of its 1.1 billion baht covertible debentures.
STA said in a statement received by Reuters on Friday that the second interest payment of its five-year convertible debentures was due on September 28.
STA said it had requested the cooperation of holders of its 1994-1999 debentures not to take legal actions against the company in response to its failure to pay the due interest.
The company said it has proposed a financial restructuring plan to several groups of creditors as part of its corporate rehabilitation plan on which it hoped to reach an agreement soon.
